plans.note: No liability-cap heading appears in the supplied outline, but the outline is plainly partial (sections 3, 4, 6, 9, 11 and everything after 12 are not listed), so a limitation of liability very likely sits in an unlisted section; check the text adjacent to the indemnity in sec-12 and the warranty/disclaimer language in sec-8. Confirm the cap is mutual and that TrueLink's cap is not the sole remedy.

Section 12 (INDEMNITY) is the operative clause. Verify TrueLink indemnifies Client for third-party IP infringement in the licensed software and hosted site and for its own negligence/wilful misconduct, and that any Client-side indemnity in sec-12 or flowing from the Client covenants in sec-8 (and the e-mail obligations in sec-7) stays narrow and reciprocal.

Scan the Client covenants in sec-8 and the licence scope in sec-2 for any restraint on the businesses Client may operate or competing products it may build or buy; nothing in the outline signals a non-compete, so likely absent.

Hosting deals sometimes make the vendor the sole provider of the hosted site; check sec-2 for exclusivity dressed up as licence scope and sec-8 for a Client covenant not to host elsewhere. No exclusivity heading appears, so likely absent.

Any most-favoured-nation language would sit in sec-5 (COMPENSATION). Only flag if it obliges Client to give TrueLink its best terms; an MFN running in Client's favour is welcome and not to be redlined.
Check the Client covenants in sec-8 and any personnel provisions bundled into the confidentiality section (sec-10) for a no-hire; nothing in the outline suggests one, so likely absent.

No term/termination heading is listed, but the outline is truncated after sec-12; locate the termination article and confirm Client may terminate on reasonable notice without penalty and that TrueLink has no mid-term convenience exit. Cross-check sec-5 for any termination fee or accelerated-fee mechanic.

Auto-renewal and the non-renewal notice window would sit in the unlisted term section; check any renewal price-uplift language against sec-5 (COMPENSATION). Flag only if the notice window is unreasonably long or renewal pricing is uncapped and unpredictable.

Governing law and venue will be in the unlisted general/miscellaneous provisions after sec-12. Accept NY, DE, CA or England and Wales with court jurisdiction; note but do not flag an accepted-but-not-preferred forum.

Assignment/change-of-control sits in the unlisted miscellaneous provisions. Confirm Client may assign to affiliates and to a successor in a merger or sale without TrueLink consent, and that TrueLink cannot terminate on Client's change of control.

Ownership will turn on the definitions in sec-1 and the licence grant in sec-2; confirm Client retains all rights in its content, customer data, marks and any site materials it supplies, and that hosting does not vest ownership or a broad data licence in TrueLink. Sec-10 may carry the correlative confidentiality/data protections.

Section 2 (LICENSE) read with the defined terms in sec-1 is the target. Check the grant is not revocable at will, and that use by Client affiliates and contractors acting for Client is permitted; territory and term limits should match the agreement term.

Any right for TrueLink to audit Client records or usage would most likely be attached to the fee mechanics in sec-5 or the Client covenants in sec-8. If present, require notice, business-hours/off-site conduct, limited frequency and vendor-borne cost.

Look for penalties or fixed damages payable by Client in sec-5 (late fees, minimum charges) and in sec-7, where breach of the unsolicited commercial e-mail restrictions is a plausible hook for a per-message penalty. Service credits running to Client are fine.

Section 8 covers only Client's warranties; TrueLink's performance warranty (and any disclaimer) should be in the parallel unlisted vendor covenants/warranties section. Confirm a meaningful hosting/software warranty with a repair-or-refund remedy, and check for an all-caps AS IS disclaimer.

No insurance heading appears in the outline; as TrueLink hosts the site and handles Client data, propose a standard insurance covenant (commercial general liability, tech E&O/cyber) if none is found in the unlisted sections.
Section 5 (COMPENSATION) is the only place a minimum fee, guaranteed volume or take-or-pay commitment would appear; flag only if a minimum is imposed without a corresponding exit right.

Check the unlisted termination provisions and the return-of-materials language likely embedded in sec-10 (CONFIDENTIALITY) for return of Client data and site content; if there is no migration/transition assistance obligation on TrueLink, treat as missing and propose one.
